relations.subject: Walter Nowick
relations.evidence: Nowick went to Japan in 1950 to study Zen with Zuigan Gotō of Daitoku-ji. Nowick stayed in Japan for around 16 years until Zuigan Gotō's death in 1965.

relations.subject: Walter Nowick
relations.evidence: During Nowick's years in Japan he supported himself teaching piano and voice at the Kyoto Women's University.

relations.subject: Sōkō Morinaga
relations.evidence: Three students of Zuigan Gotō are listed: Oda Sessō, Sōkō Morinaga and Walter Nowick.
